description:
Is the all-new Audi Q7 the ultimate 7-seat SUV?

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s flown over to France for his first drive of the all-new Audi Q7! 

It’s the third generation of Audi’s flagship 7-seater, but the question is, does it have what it takes to compete with class-leading competitors like the BMW X7 and Mercedes GLS? Let’s take a closer look…

Starting with the design, the new Q7 has more road presence than the previous iteration. The car is slightly wider and taller than before, and up front you’ll find a wider, larger grille which is flanked on either side by Audi’s new stacked headlight design. There’s also a set of DRLs that can display a choice of different patterns within them. Along the side, the alloy sizes range from 20” to 23”, and the car here has black surrounds on the windows and black roof bars. Around the back, you’ll find a set of OLED tail lights, and amazingly, a pair of real exhaust pipes - no fakery here
title: NEW Audi Q7: The ultimate SUV?
